name: 12405-batchdecode-llama4scout-8gpu
parallelism: tp8 over the eight GPUs of one node. No EP, no DP attention, no PP.
architecture: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration mixture of experts, 109B total with 17B active, 48 decoder layers, hidden 5120, 40 query and 8 key/value heads at head_dim 128. Text only here; the checkpoint's vision tower is not entered.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup discards the first 25%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. 128 is declared, not a starting value for a search.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens, both stdev 0, `prefix_tokens: 0`, temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true.
purpose: A long-form text generation service on a 109-billion-parameter expert model, serving 128 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Llama-4-Scout-Instruct, text only, on eight H100s of one node, all eight ranks tensor-parallel.
# Pin the revision if the repo is ever republished: fc1b4f4cea92cfc13570f504a209eb4d4ca81534.
# Startup is slow: expect ~9 minutes from launch to first healthy response, most of it loading
# weights, plus ~40 s of CUDA graph capture, and that sits outside `safety_seconds`.
model-path: RedHatAI/Llama-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct-FP8-dynamic
tp-size: 8
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
context-length: 131072

# fp8_e4m3 KV pairs with the fa3 backend. One expected log line to ignore — "Using FP8 KV cache
# but no scaling factors provided. Defaulting to scaling factors of 1.0." — this checkpoint ships
# no `k_scale`/`v_scale`.
attention-backend: fa3
kv-cache-dtype: fp8_e4m3

# Above the 128 offered streams, so the decode batch sizes this run visits are captured.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 512

# The prompts are random synthetic tokens with no shared prefix, so there is nothing to reuse.
disable-radix-cache: true
